multiSurfaceScope.sliceContract: all 24 journey slices are integrated in every stage

checks.proves: All financial and COD touchpoints are inventoried for boundary review.
checks.doesNotProve: Search does not prove ownership correctness.
checks.passCriteria: Every result is classified as DSH facade, WLT owner, allowed projection, or defect.
checks.failCriteria: Any direct surface-to-WLT call or local financial truth fails.

checks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "Push-Location services/wlt; if (Test-Path backend) {{ Push-Location backend; go test ./...; Pop-Location }}; Pop-Location"
checks.proves: Available WLT backend tests pass for financial truth and reconciliation.
checks.doesNotProve: The command cannot prove absent tests or live providers.
checks.passCriteria: All available WLT tests pass and required gaps are explicitly blocked.
checks.failCriteria: Any financial invariant failure or silent absence fails.

checks.command: MANUAL: execute OWASP MASVS-aligned storage, auth, network, platform, input, privacy, replay, tampering, and cross-scope tests
checks.proves: Mobile and API security controls protect field data and sensitive operations.
checks.doesNotProve: This is not a substitute for independent penetration testing.
checks.passCriteria: All applicable controls pass with evidence and residual risks documented.
checks.failCriteria: Any exploitable bypass, secret leakage, or privacy breach fails.

checks.command: MANUAL: trigger known failures and unknown-result scenarios, then trace correlation, audit, metrics, logs, Sentry release/source maps, support lookup, and reconciliation
checks.proves: Operators can diagnose and reconcile without exposing sensitive data.
checks.passCriteria: Every scenario is traceable end to end on the same SHA.
checks.failCriteria: Missing correlation, wrong release, PII leakage, or unrecoverable result fails.
